task: Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Open the door, then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) and the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) match the ordered command. The chain forces door_open, so no separate Existence is needed. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches "try not to drop the key while the door is still closed", since key_lost already encodes a drop while the door is closed.

texts: Pick up the target box (the goal the task ends on), which is required.
Open the door before picking up the box in the other room. The door opening is forced by the hard Existence of the box pickup combined with this precedence, so it needs no separate Existence clause.
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. The key_lost event is exactly that drop, so this is a soft ban.
